title: Capital now backs the strongest expression of a thesis, including outside founders
summary: The Capital page now says the firm tests whether money should move first, then backs the best founder or company working on a thesis, whether or not the firm created it.
text: An interesting idea does not automatically deserve another dollar. Capital tests the economics first, including the buying committee that meets quarterly, the security review that takes weeks, and the budget line already spent. It then searches for founders already pursuing the thesis and treats founder conversations, traction, distribution and operating capability as evidence. A new section, "Back rather than rebuild," says some of the best opportunities come from outside the firm.
